items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left and p300 right with the correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Log shows 100 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into plate A1, then 100 uL into B1, all with the p300; no other wells used.
Each aspirate/dispense happens after a pick up tip and each transfer ends with drop tip; no tip is held at the end.
100 uL is within the p300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the blow_out at the destination top is safe.
The protocol performs the single transfer step as specified; comments and metadata are accurate and no extra steps change the outcome.

judge.summary: The protocol transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and B1 using the p300 with a fresh tip each time, as the run log confirms. All rubric items pass.
